facts.text: Independent review of the test plan means people who neither wrote the plan nor need it to succeed examine what will be tested, how, and with which metrics and thresholds before testing begins.
facts.quote: Independent review of the test plan is having people who did not write the plan, and who do not need it to succeed, examine what will be tested, how, with which metrics and thresholds, before the tests begin.

facts.text: The people who built the simulator and chose the scenarios are least able to see omissions in the test plan.
facts.quote: The people who built the simulator and chose the scenarios are least able to see what the plan omits.

facts.text: Independent review brings in reviewers with no stake in the result, such as an internal safety board, an independent test body, a notified body, or a red team of skeptical experts.
facts.quote: Independent review brings in reviewers with no stake in the result: an internal safety board, an independent test body, a notified body, or a red team of skeptical experts.

facts.text: Independent review takes place before the test campaign and examines the context of use, metrics and thresholds, calibration/validation/withheld-data split, physical confirmatory tests, scenario coverage argument, and declared validity envelope.
facts.quote: Its targets are the context of use, the metrics and thresholds (fixed before results are seen), the split between calibration, validation and withheld data, the choice of physical confirmatory tests (some chosen by the reviewer), the scenario coverage argument, and the declared validity envelope

facts.text: The metrics and thresholds examined in independent test-plan review are fixed before results are seen.
facts.quote: the metrics and thresholds (fixed before results are seen)

facts.text: Some physical confirmatory tests are chosen by the independent reviewer of the test plan.
facts.quote: the choice of physical confirmatory tests (some chosen by the reviewer)

facts.text: Chapter 1 places independent test-body review of the plan before prototype safety testing.
facts.quote: Chapter 1 places "independent test-body review of the plan" before prototype safety testing

facts.text: For the preparation months, Chapter 12 suggests structured interviews, a pre-mortem with skeptics present, an independent red team, and a gate review with recorded dissent, in that order.
facts.quote: Chapter 12 suggests a sequence for the preparation months: structured interviews, a pre-mortem with the skeptics present, an independent red team, and a gate review with recorded dissent

facts.text: Chapter 13 recommends a safety and legal dry run in which reviewers see one representative evidence package months before launch.
facts.quote: Chapter 13 adds a "safety and legal dry run" in which reviewers see one representative evidence package months before launch

facts.text: Independent review cannot rescue incomplete engineering late in a project.
facts.quote: Independent review cannot rescue incomplete engineering late in a project

facts.text: Independent-review queues can become the project's critical path.
facts.quote: review queues can become the critical path [Chapter 1]

facts.text: The assessor's list includes a record of qualified people and independent review because high-criticality decisions should not depend solely on model developers' judgment.
facts.quote: "A record of qualified people and independent review" is on the assessor's list because high-criticality decisions should not depend solely on the model developers' judgment

facts.text: The booklet found no evidence that red teams improve engineering outcomes.
facts.quote: The booklet found no evidence that red teams improve engineering outcomes

facts.text: Independent review is a safeguard supported by practice and standards, not a proven cure for engineering problems.
facts.quote: independent review is a safeguard supported by practice and the standards, not a proven cure [Chapter 12]
